pageProps.title: The Good Son
pageProps.review: A review of an overwhelming thriller novel by Jeong You-jeong that deeply explores pure evil within human nature amidst fragments of lost memory and the death of a mother encountered upon waking up blood-soaked one morning.
pageProps.description: The birth of a predator, a record of those 3 days
pageProps.content:
## Review The work begins with a scene where the protagonist wakes up smelling blood in his house. Memory from the previous night is cut off, and his whole body is covered in blood. Going downstairs, he finds the body of his mother, who was murdered with her throat slit by a razor. In the terrible situation, only one thought dominates his head: ```Last night, what happened in this house?```
In this situation, the reader follows the protagonist in inferring the culprit amidst confusion and fear.
This work explores pure evil itself. I think it's a book that approaches the theme of ```evil```, which Jeong You-jeong has consistently dug into, at the most profound and fundamental level.
Personally, the process of finding the truth along with the reader from a first-person perspective and the shocking truth remain in my memory.
